refnamediv.refpurpose: Specify the method how the SNMP values will be returned

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
method
types
SNMP_VALUE_LIBRARY The return values will be as returned by the Net-SNMP library.
SNMP_VALUE_PLAIN The return values will be the plain value without the SNMP type information.
SNMP_VALUE_OBJECT
The return values will be objects with the properties value and type, where the latter is the type of the value, for example SNMP_OCTET_STR. Note that SNMP_COUNTER (66) is the type of Gauge32 values; Counter32 values have the type 65, for which there is no constant. The way value is returned depends on whether SNMP_VALUE_PLAIN is set: without it, which is SNMP_VALUE_LIBRARY (0), the value is formatted as returned by the Net-SNMP library.
